phases.name: One-day build: infra branch + dashboard branch, one PR
phases.gate: terraform validate clean; PR from feat/dashboard into feat/azure-cd deploys successfully; unauthenticated dashboard/ingest access rejected; a real Pi wake cycle produces a visible dashboard row within 30s; a retried event_id upserts instead of duplicating (ADR-0014); events pushed while offline appear once connectivity returns, via sync_queue.jsonl (ADR-0015); ruff+mypy clean across cloud/ and agent/

tasks.summary: Branch feat/dashboard (developed and validated locally; feat/azure-cd is created later from the finished feat/dashboard -- see 02-delivery.md 'Branch & Commit Strategy', revised 2026-07-14). Terraform (cloud/infra/): Storage Account (Blob 'snapshots' + Table 'events', F02), Container App Environment + Container App (scale-to-zero, F01/F04/F05 runtime), ghcr.io pull credential, secret/env blocks for DASHBOARD_PASSWORD + Storage connection string. GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/deploy.yml) pre-written to trigger on PR (opened/synchronize) into feat/azure-cd. terraform validate/plan and workflow YAML lint are the local gate; the pipeline is actually proven end-to-end once feat/azure-cd exists (after all four tasks are done) and a PR is opened against it.

Branch feat/dashboard (off feat/rpi). cloud/app/: FastAPI app with POST/GET /api/events, GET /api/events/{id} (F01), require_basic_auth() dependency applied globally (F05, shared ids/ids-default credential), server-rendered dashboard pages -- event list, real/false/email-rate metrics band, per-event detail with image + Gemini reasoning + email status (F04). Pydantic schema validation + 2MB image cap on ingest. Unit tests for auth rejection and payload validation.

On feat/dashboard. agent/machine.py: generate event_id (ULID) at decision time, capture email_sent from notifier.notify() outcome, add both to _log_event()'s local record. agent/cloud_sync.py: build_payload()/push()/flush_queue() with (3,5)s bounded timeout, shared Basic Auth credential from config.Settings, never raises. agent/sync_queue.py (ADR-0015): bounded local JSONL queue (sync_queue.jsonl, cap 20 events, 5 flushed/cycle, 5 attempts/event before drop) -- enqueue on push failure, flush_queue() retries oldest-first after every cycle's own push, stopping at first failure. config.py: CLOUD_SYNC_*/SYNC_QUEUE_* constants + Settings.cloud_sync_user/cloud_sync_password (optional, not required). Unit tests for cloud_sync.py (mocked HTTP, mirrors tests/test_notifier.py) and sync_queue.py (cap eviction, attempts tracking, corrupted-line tolerance). Depends on T04 being deployed first (server must accept client-supplied event_id before this can push successfully). Open the feat/dashboard -> feat/azure-cd PR (triggers T01's pipeline); once deployed, manually trigger a real wake cycle and confirm the event appears within 30s, then run the offline-then-reconnect check (01-system-overview.md Evaluation Framework).

On feat/dashboard, retrofitting T02's already-shipped cloud/app/ (ADR-0014, driven by T03's new local retry queue). schemas.py: EventIn gains a required event_id field, validated as a well-formed ULID (26-char Crockford base32), 422 on anything else. routes_api.py: ingest_event() no longer calls storage.generate_ulid() -- uses payload.event_id instead. storage.py: write_event() becomes an upsert (create_or_replace) keyed on the client-supplied event_id instead of a strict create, so a retried event_id overwrites identical data rather than erroring/duplicating; write_blob() is already overwrite=True and needs no change. Unit tests: upsert idempotency (same event_id posted twice yields one row, second response still 202 with the same event_id), malformed event_id rejected with 422. Must merge/deploy before T03's Pi-side retries have anything correct to push against.

On feat/dashboard (ADR-0016), backend half of a premium chart-driven dashboard UI refresh (frontend built separately, see docs/handoff/dashboard-ui-premium-refresh.md). cloud/app/metrics.py (new): summary_metrics() (moved from routes_dashboard.py, same real/false/non-escalating/email-rate logic), daily_rollup() (per-UTC-date counts, oldest first), vision_source_breakdown() (outcome x vision_source cross-tab -- an operational/model-agreement breakdown, explicitly NOT a ground-truth confusion matrix), latency_stats() (avg/p50/p95/max over latency_s). storage.py: list_events_for_metrics(since) -- same partition-key-range query as list_events() but uncapped (aggregation must cover the whole window, not the 500-row display cap). routes_api.py: new GET /api/metrics?since= route (same Basic Auth, same app). routes_dashboard.py: compute_metrics() now delegates to metrics.summary_metrics() (one implementation, not two). Unit tests for every metrics.py function plus the route (auth-gated, correct JSON shape, daily rollup ordering, empty-window edge case). Later amended in place (2026-07-15, same branch, no new task): trigger_breakdown, gemini_call_success_rate, last_sync fields added to GET /api/metrics (ADR-0016 addenda), and window_broken/window_break_confirmation_rate added end-to-end (ADR-0017).

On feat/dashboard (ADR-0018), the follow-up ADR-0016 explicitly deferred: manual ground-truth review, closing the gap that made vision_source_breakdown/trigger_breakdown operational breakdowns rather than real accuracy measurements. schemas.py: EventReview (window_broken_confirmed, intrusion_confirmed, both required, extra=forbid) request body for a new PATCH /api/events/{event_id} route; EventSummary/EventDetail gain window_broken_confirmed, intrusion_confirmed, reviewed_at (all nullable, unreviewed by default); ConfusionCounts/ReviewAccuracy response models. storage.py: _find_entity_by_row_key() helper (shared by get_event(), refactored to use it, and the new review_event()); review_event() looks up the entity by RowKey, then update_entity(mode=MERGE) writes the three review fields -- same pattern set_blob_name() already established for a cloud-side patch onto an existing entity. metrics.py: _confusion() (TP/FP/TN/FN + accuracy helper) and review_accuracy() (scoped to events with a real Gemini verdict AND a completed review), surfaced as a new top-level review_accuracy field on GET /api/metrics. routes_api.py: new PATCH /api/events/{event_id} route (200 + updated EventDetail, 404 if event_id unknown, same Basic Auth as every route); get_metrics() wires review_accuracy(events) into the response. Unit tests: storage.review_event() found/not-found + MERGE payload verification, PATCH route (200/404/422/re-review overwrite), metrics._confusion()/review_accuracy() (empty, mixed TP/FP/TN/FN, excludes failsafe verdicts, excludes unreviewed events), test_auth.py route-enumeration update, test_metrics.py route-shape update.
